_about: The Pacific war's ties (ruling 197, the offer of war: the Pacific planner's paper 12, /mnt/project-files/pacific-planner/12-the-offer-of-war.md), read by src/campaign/pacific.ts and only while the far side's switch is on. 'power' is the country the ties are written for, which begins outside both blocs leaning to 'bloc'. It counts as that bloc's co-belligerent from the month it is at war with a member of the other bloc that is at war with a member of this one, and from that month 'china', at war with it since the first day, stands with the other bloc. 'pair': when the power is at war with one of the two and the two stand together in an alliance, the other is at war with it the month after. 'with': the countries that are at war with the power the same day one of the pair is, while they stand in its alliance (its dominions are world.json's, 'follow'). 'pact': the months from which Germany and Italy are bound to the power's war with 'with' (the far-pacific-war.json event 'pact-binds'): 'book' at the stops of the history dial that keep the book, and at the others so many 'months' after 'fallen' is beaten. 'freeze': America's sales to the power (and the south's) stop on 'book' at the stops that keep the book; at the others the month after the power holds one of 'places', and at every stop the month after it is at war with one of 'wars'. Once come it does not lift. 'north': the computer's 'nat' goes to war with the power so many 'months' after 'fallen' is beaten, while the power is still at war with one of 'while', and at the stops that keep the book not before 'book'. Until then the two computers keep the peace: no great choice of either names the other. The news lines are 'says' (the freeze's are ruling 197's own words, for the countries named here).

says.beside: {Power} fights beside the Axis: it is at war with {foe}, and {foe} is at war with {axis}.
says.china: {China} stands with the Allies: {power} fights beside the Axis, and their enemy is one.
says.freeze: America has stopped selling oil and steel to Japan.
says.freezeBoth: Britain and the Dutch have done the same.
says.freezeDutch: The Dutch have done the same.
says.north: Three months after {fallen}'s defeat {nat} turns east.
